description.narrative: PEF coordination with Oxfam will provide shelter/household NFI kits to 250 affected HHs. In line withstandardized Shelter Cluster NFIs, kitchen <(>&<)> cooking, bedding kits and LEDs with batteries will be distributed tothe 250 displaced HHs to mitigate the electricity shortage, protection risks and improve sense of safety.Vulnerable households will be prioritized in accordance with MoSD’s vulnerability parameters such as age,disability, families with high numbers of dependents, women-headed households and families who suffer fromharsh living conditions and protection concerns. At least 10% of each list will be validated to ensure propertargeting based on the selection criteria. Validation will be conducted through phone calls by Oxfam and partners’team. The final list will be shared with the shelter Cluster and MoSD to crosscheck and avoid duplication. PEFwill follow up the distribution process in the field. Effective coordination with MoSD and the Shelter cluster willbe in place to identify the target locations. NFIs will be provided through contracting pre-qualified privatevendors/suppliers by PEF and YEC. NFI cannot be distributed through the E-voucher modality since the itemsare not offered in one store/shop like the HK items which are normally purchased from groceries or anysupermarket. In Gaza’s local market, the NFI kit items are sold through three separate stores/traders (i.e.mattresses and blankets; cooking and kitchen items; batteries and LEDs

participating-org.narrative: The Palestinian Environmental Friends Association is a non-profit organization (Nongovernmental Organization). It was establishmentin 1998 by a group of Palestinian experts to meet the demand needed in the field of the environment and natural resources.The establishment of PEF enables environmental friends all over the world to cooperate neglecting geological and political constrains to stopthe negative impacts on the environment. Together, we create a universal free from pollution, sustainable and suitable for new generations. PEF practiced projects almost all over Gaza Strip. The projects activities mainly covered the following areas: Water and wastewater, public health, global warming, infrastructure and capacity building activities, compost production, solid wastes and awareness programs. The association aim is to share in improving the environmental situation in the Palestinian territories, also, to protect the local environment, and public health natural resources from pollution and mining. Public awareness <(>&<)> environmental education is one of the organization aims to have sustainable and well-managed natural resources in addition of rehabilitation of Water and Sewerage Infrastructure in Northern Gaza Governorate . PEF aims to have a wide range ofcooperation with local, regional and international organizations and individuals share its aims and activities
